title: 小小英文新鲜事 - 1024 | 巨型吹风机、变色虾眼、深海巨虫
description:
🎧 本期音频为全英文，适合有一定英语基础的小朋友。

👧 今天 Mia 和 Lina 聊了三个新鲜事：

💇 两个小朋友画的巨型吹风机真的被造出来了！长一米七五、能正常吹风，还进了吉尼斯世界纪录！
🦐 螳螂虾的眼睛像电灯开关，能看到我们想象不到的颜色，一开一关切换自如！
🪲 一只来自波多黎各的深海巨虫在德国博物馆抽屉里躺了几十年，挂错名牌后终于被认出是新物种！

📖 Word of the day: switch（开关）

🎮 谜语时间：我比大人还高、会吹热风，但我不是龙——我是谁？答案：巨型吹风机！

---
🇬🇧 In today's episode:

💇 Two kids dreamed up a giant hairdryer, and engineers actually built it — one point seven meters long, fully working, and now in the Guinness World Records book!
🦐 A mantis shrimp's eyes work like a light switch, seeing colors we cannot even imagine!
🪲 A giant isopod from Puerto Rico sat in a German museum drawer for decades under the wrong name before scientists recognized it as a new species!

📖 Word of the day: switch

🎮 Riddle time: I am bigger than a grown-up, I blow hot air, but I am not a dragon! What am I? A giant hairdryer!

📝 生词本 Words to learn

1. switch（开关）
a little button that turns something on or off
例：flip the switch（拨动开关）

2. invention（发明）
something new that someone makes for the first time
例：a wild invention（一个奇思妙想的发明）

3. isopod（深海巨虫）
a sea animal with a hard shell that looks like a giant woodlouse
例：a giant isopod（一只深海巨虫）

4. record（纪录）
the best ever in something
例：a world record（世界纪录）
